reviewed_by: Claude (red-ui-suites bug loop); selection reviewed against the diff by the implementing agent, triage and the operator race independently validated by a separate subagent
reason: Activating an operator profile also changes the former active profile's revision, but SettingsPage disabled only the activated row while the request and list refresh ran, so a quick Edit of the former active profile saved a stale revision and got a 409. All operator rows now wait while any operator change is in flight (SettingsPage.tsx). The same change repairs 14 frontend tests that were red on main and never selected: SettingsPage.test mocks MemoryBudgetSettings; App.test awaits the shell behind ea9c8cf's entry gate, answers runtime/identity, host-pressure and memory-budgets with real shapes, loads fake-indexeddb, gives the long provider test the file's 15 s timeout, and holds the operator activation to assert every row stays disabled.
exclusions: Python, native and Playwright are empty: no Core change, and no mocked Playwright spec covers operator profiles (only real-core.spec.ts, which CI does not run); playwright_impact select returned no areas. Dogfooded on the staging Core in desktop Chromium: with activation delayed 1.5 s both rows' Edit buttons stay disabled, then editing the former active profile saves with 200 and no conflict. Both files pass 3 of 3 full runs locally (59 tests).
